description: This file defines the CsrfDefenseStrategy class implementing CSRF protection logic, including token generation, request validation, and error handling within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: CsrfDefenseStrategy
classes.description: Implements CSRF defense strategies including token generation, validation, and response handling.

methods.name: generateToken
methods.description: Generates a random CSRF token string of length 12 using SecureRandom.

methods.name: maxSubFolderInRequestUrlForTokenMapLookup
methods.description: Returns request limit for URLs starting with 'entity/', otherwise 0.

methods.name: modifySecurityCsrfToken
methods.description: Determines if CSRF token should be modified based on request URI and token value.

methods.name: keepTokenAfterUse
methods.description: Indicates whether to keep the CSRF token after use, allowing GET requests to retain the token.

methods.name: invalidTokenResponse
methods.description: Handles invalid or missing CSRF tokens by setting an error message and throwing an exception.
